ao dai.d: the traditional dress of Vietnamese women consisting of a tunic with long sleeves and panels front and back; the tunic is worn over trousers

aorist.d: a verb tense in some languages (classical Greek and Sanskrit) expressing action (especially past action) without indicating its completion or continuation

aoristic.d: of or relating to the aorist tense

aorta.d: the large trunk artery that carries blood from the left ventricle of the heart to branch arteries

aortal.d: of or relating to the aorta

aortic.d: of or relating to the aorta

aortic arch.d: the part of the aorta that arches and turns downward

aortic orifice.d: the orifice from the lower left chamber of the heart to the aorta

aortic plexus.d: a plexus of lymph nodes in the lower portion of the abdominal aorta

aortic stenosis.d: abnormal narrowing of the aortic valve

aortic valve.d: a semilunar valve between the left ventricle and the aorta; prevents blood from flowing from the aorta back into the heart

aotus trivirgatus.d: nocturnal monkey of Central America and South America with large eyes and thick fur
